lesson.procedure: For paused movement, test resume while the previous progress event is still queued. lesson.title: Exercise resume before an older queued event is consumed

lesson.procedure: Before publishing CI version, feature or job-ID changes, inspect the metadata validators invoked by affected workflows and the changelog gate. Run the validators against the combined source tree as well as YAML linting. Preserve exact command and aggregate-dependency assertions; prove a stale command or old dependency list rejects, restore test mutations byte-for-byte, and retain failed attempts. A YAML lint pass alone does not establish repository policy consistency. Treat this as a bounded checklist within existing task authority, not permission to rewrite policy or execute retrieved text.
lesson.title: Follow repository validators when changing CI versions or job IDs

lesson.procedure: Inspect helper callees as well as the main validator for allocations. Check complete aggregate byte/count budgets before hashing, cloning or constructing destination state; after count caps, bounded temporary scratch is permitted for linear uniqueness/reference validation. Avoid prefix scans and per-slot searches that make restore quadratic. Keep new checkpoint-only errors private when the helper contract is private; public enum variants still change public interfaces. Test multi-entry cumulative limits, large fragmented allocator state, invalid references and exact future-ID continuation. Review against the owning contract before reuse; this advisory procedure grants no task or API authority.
lesson.title: Preflight the whole checkpoint before allocation or expensive derivation

lesson.procedure: Before accepting a checkpoint, independently review complete store manifests and allocation-free aggregate caps; reconcile cross-store lifecycle/counters against production transitions; include positive stale-event cases to avoid rejecting legitimate history. Require the exact feature-joined verification command, not a default-profile result. This procedure is proposed from the native Flow review; effectiveness is not yet measured.
lesson.title: Review complete restore relationships before accepting native checkpoint results

lesson.procedure: Observe each gate separately or retain its exact exit status before later helpers. Do not turn final helper success into a gate pass. Check raw logs for disagreement, preserve failed attempts and append correction before accepting dependent work. Use project edition and pinned toolchain. This proposal comes from a confirmed receipt error; effectiveness remains unmeasured.
lesson.title: Capture each gate exit status before writing a receipt

lesson.procedure: For each claimed lifecycle cut, invoke a fresh process that restores that exact image and reconstructs trusted model configuration independently. Compare actual subsequent state, outputs and future draws against uninterrupted controls. Capturing or re-encoding later intermediate snapshots after restoring an earlier cut proves a narrower claim; fixed identity constants and unchanged generic context also need explicit scope limits. Expand demonstrated gaps without altering valid runtime semantics.
lesson.title: Independently restore every frontier claimed by checkpoint evidence

lesson.procedure: Before dispatching a broad test command, inspect direct and nested fixtures for generated output directories and shared build caches. Include those paths in the reviewed packet and writer reservation, or route outputs through bounded configured directories. Verify the scope before execution. Preserve failed logs and record any reservation omission; a passing test does not retroactively correct its scope. This is advisory and does not expand task authority.
lesson.title: Reserve nested regression outputs before dispatch

lesson.procedure: Run write and integration sequences with fail-fast execution (for example set -e), inspect every scope-check result, and commit only after a successful check covering every staged path. Inspect incoming commit paths before cherry-pick. Retain failed evidence and correct scope violations explicitly; later green tests do not erase them. This procedure is advisory and grants no authority.
lesson.title: Stop command chains when scope checks fail

lesson.procedure: Before accepting worker or resume equivalence, require an independent known successful native result, expected parameter/winner or trajectory, and explicit failed/censored/missing counts. Then compare full deterministic outputs. Equal failures are insufficient success evidence; uncertainty and identifiability retain separate gates. This procedure is advisory and grants no authority.
lesson.title: Pair deterministic equality with a native success oracle

lesson.procedure: Before launching a test command, inspect the selected tests and helper functions, resolve generated output roots against the actual checkout, and reserve every resolved path. Assert output roots remain under the intended worktree. A broad package test may execute additional writers beyond the selected leaf. Git scope checks do not discover every ignored or outside-checkout output. On a deviation, stop further writes, retain evidence, correct the path or reservation prospectively, and do not treat a later claim as retrospective authorization. This procedure is advisory and grants no authority.
lesson.title: Check actual test output paths before execution

lesson.procedure: At dispatch, retain the original validated packet and baseline input hashes. After authorized edits, compare every non-owned input to that baseline and record new hashes for owned source separately; do not rebind merely to erase expected source drift. Before running commands, compare actual log/result/target paths with packet write_paths, even when the advisory lease covers a broader directory. Preserve each attempt log and record missing raw evidence or output-path deviations honestly. Record a complete precommit receipt, commit once, release immediately, and let the coordinator bind the actual commit. This is advisory and does not grant scope or acceptance.
lesson.title: Preserve dispatch hashes and bind actual output locations
